name: Visual Dialog: Multi-Turn Conversational Visual Question Answering
description: Visual Dialog (VisDial v1.0) is a multimodal benchmark for multi-turn visual conversation. In each dialogue, two participants converse about an image from COCO: one acts as the questioner and the other as the answerer, generating 10 multi-turn question-answer exchanges per image across 133,351 dialogues.
